component.name: Starling
component.summary: Run a Mumble voice server on this machine

description.p: Starling is a Mumble server written in Rust. It speaks the standard Mumble protocol, so any Mumble client can connect to it, and it runs as a single process with no database server or web stack to set up first.
Start it with the all-in-one flag and it writes a configuration file, creates the administrator account, and prints a SuperUser password once. Point a Mumble client at localhost:64738 and log in.

Configuration lives in the application's own config directory and the databases, TLS identity and service sockets in its data directory. The TLS certificate is how clients recognise this server, so that directory is worth backing up: replacing it looks, to every client that has connected before, like a different server.
This package runs the server in the foreground, under your user account. For a server supervised by systemd at boot, use the distribution packages or the container image instead.
